prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent hero artwork for the new five-item cosmetic trade-up game in FPTU Xperience, matching an existing midnight titanium and champagne-gold arcade.
Primary request: a premium compact five-input fusion apparatus, an original game asset that visually explains exchanging five collectibles for one upgraded reward.
Subject: a low, finely crafted pentagonal dark titanium workstation, five equally spaced circular receiving docks with champagne-brass rims around a central recessed crystal reaction chamber. The five docks are visibly EMPTY, no items or symbols inside. Central chamber contains a restrained warm golden energy glow under clear faceted glass. Precise machined seams, brushed alloy, tiny warm status lights, subtle iridescent crystal reflections.
Style: high-end physically rendered 3D collectible game prop, sophisticated cinematic product lighting, believable bevels and material detail. Refined, not cartoon, no weapons.
Composition: single apparatus centered in a wide landscape composition, elevated three-quarter camera with all FIVE docks visible. Entire prop fits with ample transparent margins; silhouette is clean, a subtle grounded shadow only beneath the apparatus. Keep it compact and readable at 500px web width.
Backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha. Intended to layer on a midnight navy webpage.
Palette: midnight titanium #111c28, dark slate #253346, champagne #e7bd83, subtle ice-blue glass. Controlled light, not neon haze.
Constraints: ONE device, exactly five receiving docks, no text, letters, numbers, UI panels, logos, shields, badges, club emblems or watermarks. No gun skins, no Valve/CS branding. No explosive particles, no fog, no cropped edges, no opaque background.
